note: Original passages written for the site, Traditional Chinese in Taiwan wording. The pinyin of every sentence, question and option is generated (tools/zh_reading.py) — the build prints it for review; give a line its own pinyin as {"t": "…", "p": "…"}. Simplified and zhuyin are made from it per character. Translations and glossary meanings: English (zh may stay empty). Edit this file, then run: python tools/build_reading.py

s: 我每天早上七點起床。
早飯是麵包和雞蛋。
paragraphs.en: I get up at seven every morning. Breakfast is bread and eggs.

s: 八點我出門，坐公車去學校。
在學校，我跟朋友一起學中文。
paragraphs.en: At eight I leave home and take the bus to school. At school I study Chinese with my friends.

s: 中午我和朋友在學校的餐廳吃飯。
下午我在圖書館看書。
paragraphs.en: At noon I eat with my friends in the school cafeteria. In the afternoon I read in the library.

s: 晚上我在家做晚飯。
然後看電視，十一點睡覺。
paragraphs.en: In the evening I cook dinner at home. Then I watch TV and go to bed at eleven.

glossary.en: to sleep; to go to bed

mcq.q: 這個人每天早上幾點起床？
mcq.zh: 「我每天早上七點起床」。八點是出門的時間。
mcq.en: “我每天早上七點起床” — seven o'clock. Eight is when they leave home.
“坐公車去學校” — by bus.

mcq.zh: 「中午我和朋友在學校的餐廳吃飯」。
mcq.en: “中午我和朋友在學校的餐廳吃飯” — in the school cafeteria.

mcq.zh: 「下午我在圖書館看書」。看電視和做晚飯是晚上。
mcq.en: “下午我在圖書館看書” — reading. TV and cooking are in the evening.
“十一點睡覺” — at eleven.

tf.en: False: breakfast is 麵包和雞蛋 (bread and eggs).

tf.s: 他在學校跟朋友一起學中文。
tf.zh: ○：「在學校，我跟朋友一起學中文」。
tf.en: True: 在學校，我跟朋友一起學中文.

tf.zh: ×：「晚上我在家做晚飯」，在家自己做。
tf.en: False: in the evening they cook dinner at home (在家做晚飯).

s: 星期天，我和朋友小雨去了車站附近一家新開的咖啡店。
paragraphs.en: On Sunday my friend Xiaoyu and I went to a new café near the station.

s: 咖啡店很漂亮，人很多。
我買了咖啡和蛋糕，小雨喝了一杯茶。
paragraphs.en: The café was very pretty and crowded. I bought coffee and cake; Xiaoyu had a cup of tea.

s: 蛋糕有一點貴，可是非常好吃。
咖啡不太甜。
paragraphs.en: The cake was a little expensive, but very good. The coffee wasn't very sweet.

s: 我們聊了兩個小時。
下個星期我還想跟她一起去。
paragraphs.en: We talked for two hours. Next week I want to go with her again.

mcq.q: 他們什麼時候去咖啡店？
mcq.zh: 「星期天，我和朋友小雨去了…咖啡店」。
mcq.en: “星期天…去了…咖啡店” — on Sunday.

mcq.zh: 「車站附近一家新開的咖啡店」。
mcq.en: “車站附近一家新開的咖啡店” — near the station.

mcq.zh: 「小雨喝了一杯茶」。喝咖啡的是「我」。
mcq.en: “小雨喝了一杯茶”. The coffee was the writer's.

mcq.zh: 「蛋糕有一點貴，可是非常好吃」。
mcq.en: “蛋糕有一點貴，可是非常好吃” — a little expensive but very good.
“我們聊了兩個小時” — two hours.

tf.en: False: 人很多 — it was crowded.
False: 咖啡不太甜 — not very sweet.

tf.s: 下個星期我還想去那家咖啡店。
tf.zh: ○：「下個星期我還想跟她一起去」。
tf.en: True: 下個星期我還想跟她一起去.

s: 這個星期六，我要跟家人一起去海邊。
我們早上很早就開車出發。
paragraphs.en: This Saturday I'm going to the seaside with my family. We'll set off by car very early in the morning.

s: 到海邊要三個小時。
在車上，我跟妹妹一起唱歌。
paragraphs.en: It takes three hours to get to the sea. In the car I sing songs with my little sister.

s: 到了海邊，大家一起游泳。
中午我們吃媽媽做的飯。
paragraphs.en: At the seaside we all go swimming. At noon we eat the food my mother made.

s: 電視上說星期六是晴天。
我很高興！
paragraphs.en: The TV says Saturday will be sunny. I'm so happy!

mcq.en: “我要跟家人一起去海邊” — with the family.
“開車出發” — by car.
“到海邊要三個小時” — three hours.
“在車上，我跟妹妹一起唱歌” — singing with the sister.
“中午我們吃媽媽做的飯” — the food mother made.

tf.en: False: they leave very early in the morning.
True: 到了海邊，大家一起游泳.
False: the TV says Saturday will be sunny (晴天).

s: 今天從早上開始一直下大雨，有一點冷。
paragraphs.en: It has been raining hard all day since this morning, and it's a little cold.

s: 我帶著傘，坐公車去公司。
公車上人很多。
paragraphs.en: I took my umbrella and went to work by bus. There were a lot of people on the bus.

s: 在公司附近，我看見一隻白色的貓。
貓在樹下看著雨。
paragraphs.en: Near the office I saw a white cat. The cat was watching the rain under a tree.

s: 到了晚上，雨已經停了。
回家的路上，我在麵包店買了好吃的麵包。
paragraphs.en: By evening the rain had stopped. On the way home I bought some nice bread at a bakery.

mcq.en: “一直下大雨，有一點冷” — rainy and a little cold.
“坐公車去公司” — by bus.
“公車上人很多” — lots of people.
“貓在樹下看著雨” — under a tree.

mcq.q: 回家的路上，我買了什麼？
mcq.zh: 「我在麵包店買了好吃的麵包」。
mcq.en: “我在麵包店買了好吃的麵包” — bread.

tf.en: True: 我帶著傘，坐公車去公司.
False: it was a white cat (白色的貓).
False: by evening the rain had stopped (雨已經停了).

s: 昨天我去百貨公司買媽媽的生日禮物。
paragraphs.en: Yesterday I went to the department store to buy my mother's birthday present.

s: 在三樓，我看到一個很漂亮的包包。
可是要三千塊，太貴了，所以我沒買。
paragraphs.en: On the third floor I saw a very pretty bag. But it was three thousand dollars — too expensive — so I didn't buy it.

s: 然後我去了五樓，那裡有一件藍色的毛衣，一千兩百塊。
媽媽喜歡藍色，所以我買了那件毛衣。
paragraphs.en: Then I went to the fifth floor, where there was a blue sweater for one thousand two hundred dollars. My mother likes blue, so I bought that sweater.

s: 我想快點送給媽媽。
paragraphs.en: I can't wait to give it to her.

mcq.en: “買媽媽的生日禮物” — mother's birthday present.

mcq.zh: 「在三樓，我看到一個很漂亮的包包」。毛衣在五樓。
mcq.en: “在三樓…包包”. The sweater was on the fifth floor.

mcq.zh: 「要三千塊，太貴了，所以我沒買」。
mcq.en: “太貴了，所以我沒買” — too expensive.
“一千兩百塊”. Three thousand was the bag.

mcq.q: 我為什麼買藍色的毛衣？
mcq.zh: 「媽媽喜歡藍色，所以我買了那件毛衣」。
mcq.en: “媽媽喜歡藍色” — mother likes blue.

tf.en: True: 昨天我去百貨公司….
False: the sweater was on the fifth floor (五樓); the bag was on the third.
False: the bag wasn't bought (我沒買), only the sweater.

s: 我每個星期二和星期四去上中文課。
上課時間是晚上七點。
paragraphs.en: Every Tuesday and Thursday I go to Chinese class. Class starts at seven in the evening.

s: 我們的老師是王老師。
王老師人很好，上課很有意思。
paragraphs.en: Our teacher is Ms Wang. She is very nice, and her classes are fun.

s: 我們班有八個學生，有美國人、日本人，也有泰國人。
我們一起唱中文歌，也玩遊戲。
paragraphs.en: There are eight students in our class — Americans, Japanese and Thais. We sing Chinese songs together and play games too.

s: 漢字很難，可是我每天都練習寫一點。
明年我想去台灣旅遊。
paragraphs.en: Chinese characters are hard, but I practise writing a few every day. Next year I want to travel to Taiwan.

mcq.zh: 「每個星期二和星期四去上中文課」。
mcq.en: “每個星期二和星期四” — Tuesdays and Thursdays.
“上課時間是晚上七點” — seven in the evening.

mcq.zh: 「王老師人很好，上課很有意思」。
mcq.en: “王老師人很好，上課很有意思” — nice, and the classes are fun.
“我們班有八個學生” — eight.
“明年我想去台灣旅遊” — travel to Taiwan.

tf.s: 我們班有很多台灣學生。
tf.zh: ×：學生是美國人、日本人和泰國人，沒有提到台灣學生。
tf.en: False: the students are American, Japanese and Thai — no Taiwanese students are mentioned.
False: 漢字很難 — characters are hard.
True: 我每天都練習寫一點.

s: 上個星期天，我跟弟弟去動物園。
我們在車站前面坐十二號公車。
paragraphs.en: Last Sunday I went to the zoo with my little brother. We took the number 12 bus in front of the station.

s: 公車開了二十分鐘就到了動物園。
我們在門口買了兩張票，一張一百塊。
paragraphs.en: After twenty minutes the bus got to the zoo. We bought two tickets at the gate, a hundred dollars each.

s: 動物園裡有大象、長頸鹿和貓熊。
弟弟最喜歡貓熊。
貓熊在樹上睡覺。
paragraphs.en: At the zoo there were elephants, giraffes and pandas. My brother likes pandas best. The panda was asleep up in a tree.

s: 回來的時候，公車一直不來，所以我們走路到車站，走了三十分鐘。
paragraphs.en: On the way back the bus never came, so we walked to the station. It took thirty minutes.

mcq.en: “我跟弟弟去動物園” — with the younger brother.
“坐十二號公車” — the number 12.

mcq.zh: 一張一百塊，買了兩張，一共兩百塊。
mcq.en: Two tickets at 100 dollars each — 200 in all.
“貓熊在樹上睡覺” — asleep in a tree.
“我們走路到車站” — they walked.

tf.s: 公車開了一個小時才到動物園。
tf.en: False: it took twenty minutes (二十分鐘).
False: his favourite is the panda (貓熊).

tf.s: 我們走了三十分鐘到車站。
tf.en: True: 走路到車站，走了三十分鐘.

s: 從前天開始，我的喉嚨很痛，還有一點發燒。
我感冒了。
paragraphs.en: Since the day before yesterday my throat has been very sore, and I have a slight fever. I've caught a cold.

s: 昨天我去了家附近的醫院。
醫生說：「要吃藥，多休息。」
paragraphs.en: Yesterday I went to the hospital near my home. The doctor said, “Take your medicine and rest a lot.”

s: 藥一天吃三次，飯後吃。
今天我沒去公司，在家休息。
paragraphs.en: I take the medicine three times a day, after meals. Today I didn't go to work; I rested at home.

s: 媽媽打電話說：「多喝熱水。」
晚上我喝了熱湯，很早就睡了。
明天應該會好一點。
paragraphs.en: My mother called and said, “Drink lots of hot water.” In the evening I had some hot soup and went to bed early. I should feel a bit better tomorrow.

glossary.en: to catch a cold; a cold

mcq.q: 我從什麼時候開始感冒？
mcq.en: “從前天開始” — since the day before yesterday.
The doctor said “要吃藥，多休息”.
“藥一天吃三次” — three times a day.
“飯後吃” — after meals.

mcq.zh: 「晚上我喝了熱湯，很早就睡了」。
mcq.en: “晚上我喝了熱湯，很早就睡了” — had hot soup and went to bed early.

tf.en: False: 還有一點發燒 — a slight fever.
False: 今天我沒去公司 — they stayed home.
True: 媽媽打電話說….
